findings.failure_mode: V01 did not distinguish ranking from filtering, early-stop, or rule eligibility. Candidate could win by seeing fewer/more signals rather than better priority.
Shared eligible rule pool did not prove identical symbol vocabulary and feature extraction across lanes.
Topology lane could silently create additional world variables or state nodes, increasing explanatory freedom.
Candidate could retain more competing mappings or reasoning branches than baseline and gain search capacity.
Equal raw sources did not guarantee equal interpreter context, tool access, or rule-trace budget.
A lane could improve apparent score by abstaining on difficult cases and shrinking its effective denominator.
Different output cardinality, confidence scale, or granularity could change scoring difficulty.
Interpreter awareness of candidate/comparator identity could induce expectancy effects.
Later lanes could learn from earlier lane maps or predictions unless isolation was explicit.
Version names alone do not prevent stochastic remapping or rerun drift.
C1/C2 labels stated intended attribution, but V01 did not machine-lock that all other dimensions must be equal.
Existing K2PV-QRM-001 cannot yet bind the newly required parity/blinding/denominator/determinism fields.

closure_rule: All protocol-level findings may be marked CLOSED_IN_V02 only because Batch=0/Freeze=0/Outcome=0. P2-AUD-012 remains OPEN_BLOCKER until a new prospective plan identity/version binds every V02 future_batch_freeze_required field; no Batch may be created before that repin.
non_claims: This audit does not validate topology-conditioned Role Map.
This audit does not validate fixed global priority.
This audit does not create a prospective Batch.
Closing methodological confounds does not create empirical credit.
